title: Ntlo ea Borena ea Khalase e Iponts'itsoeng
intro: Nahana ka naha e hole ea leruo le bokhabane moo letsatsi le rapeloang ho e-na le 'Mōpi oa lona. Lengolo le fihla le nkile pitso e ke keng ea hlokomolohuoa, 'me leeto le qala ho ea lekhotleng le leholo ho feta leha e le lefe le kileng la bonoa pele. Moo, thetso e tla pepesoa ke mokatong o thetsang mahlo, 'me motsotsoana oa ho hlaka o tla fetola ntho e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe.
clues: Ke ne ke busa naha e atlehileng eo batho ba eona ba neng ba khumamela letsatsi ho e-na le Allah.
Ke fumane lengolo le hlomphehang le mpiletsang hore ke se ke ka iphahamisa empa ke ikokobeletse Allah.
Ke ile ka buisana le lekgotla la heso mme ka kgetha diplomasia pele, ka romela mpho ho leka motho ya e rometseng.
Ke ile ka tla ho Sulayman, 'me terone ea ka ea borena ea hlahisoa ho 'na e ipatile ho leka ho tsebahala ha ka.
Ke kene ntlong e phahameng ea borena eo fatše e boreleli ea khalase eo ke ileng ka nahana hore ke metsi a tebileng.
Ke ile ka phatlalatsa hore ke inehetse ho Allah ho Sulayman, Morena oa lefats'e.

identity.label: Ke mang?
options: Khaitseli ea Musa
Mosadi oa Abu Lahab
Mosadi oa Nuh
Bilqis, 'Musi oa Saba
Zulaikha, Mosali oa Al-Aziz

trial.label: Nyeoe/Ketsahalo
options: E metse ke tlhapi e kgolo botebong ba lewatle
Ke ile ka otloa ke lilemo tsa ho kula le tahlehelo ea lelapa
O laetsoe ho nyehela ngoana ea ratoang torong
E lekoa ke terone e ipatileng le ntlo ea borena ea khalase
O lahleloa mollong o tukang ka lebaka la ho roba litšoantšo tse rapeloang
trial.answer: E lekoa ke terone e ipatileng le ntlo ea borena ea khalase

location.label: Karolo ea Bohlokoa
options: Areka e hahiloeng holim'a metsi
Lehaha la setšabelo bakeng sa ba robetseng
Mokato oa ntlo ea borena ea kristale (Sarh)
Noka ea Nile nakong ea ho falla ha Bajuda
Mollo o lokisitsoeng ke barapeli ba litšoantšo
location.answer: Mokato oa ntlo ea borena ea kristale (Sarh)

outcome.label: Sephetho
options: Ke ile ka metsoa ke lefats'e ka matlotlo a ka
Ke ile ka sala ke sa kholoe 'me ka timetsoa le batho ba ka
E inehetse ho Sulayman ho Allah, Morena oa lefats'e
Ho qoela leoatleng ha a ntse a lelekisa balumeli
E ile ea fetoha lejoe ka lebaka la ho roba Sabatha
outcome.answer: E inehetse ho Sulayman ho Allah, Morena oa lefats'e

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
